queue.title: Port strike delayed again at Los Angeles, Long Beach ports
queue.excerpt: A potential strike by port watchmen at Los Angeles and Long Beach has been delayed again after the Pacific Maritime Association and International Longshore and Warehouse Union Local 26 agreed to extend their contract through midnight Pacific Time on Friday.

queue.title: Maersk raises profit outlook as earnings surge, but shares slide on expectations miss
queue.excerpt: A.P. Moller-Maersk raised its full-year earnings forecast on Thursday after higher freight rates drove a sharp increase in third-quarter profit, but its shares fell as the results and upgraded outlook disappointed investors. The stock dropped as much as 11.6% in Copenhagen trading.

queue.title: EBay trims Depop shipping rates, bolsters delivery features
queue.excerpt: The company is using AI to enable fast-but-reliable delivery promises and help sellers determine shipping costs more easily, CEO Jamie Iannone said.

queue.title: Oil prices steady on possible war pullback after midterms
queue.excerpt: The possibility of pressure from Congress to pull back on the war sent the price for a barrel of Brent crude oil, the international standard, plunging 8.7% to $94.62.

queue.title: Schneider National says rail partner shift offers network boost
queue.excerpt: CEO Jim Filter said the company brings 35 years of intermodal service experience to its new partnership with Norfolk Southern.
